)

# 3. Add --force_refine argparse argument after --no_refine

    '    parser.add_argument(\"--no_refine\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"A3: disable inference-time SDF gradient refinement (evaluate training effect only)\")',
    '    parser.add_argument(\"--no_refine\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"A3: disable inference-time SDF gradient refinement (evaluate training effect only)\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--force_refine\", action=\"store_true\", default=False,\n                        help=\"Force SDF gradient refinement on every step, ignoring sdf_min threshold\")'
)

# 4. Pass force_refine to _refine_action_a3 call

    '                action, refine_info = _refine_action_a3(\n                    action, obs, suffix_hook.features,\n                    sdf_decoder, args.refine_alpha, args.refine_margin, device,\n                )',
    '                action, refine_info = _refine_action_a3(\n                    action, obs, suffix_hook.features,\n                    sdf_decoder, args.refine_alpha, args.refine_margin, device,\n                    force_refine=args.force_refine,\n                )'
)

# 5. Add force_refine to output config

    '        output[\"config\"][\"refine_enabled\"] = not args.no_refine',
    '        output[\"config\"][\"refine_enabled\"] = not args.no_refine\n        output[\"config\"][\"force_refine\"] = args.force_refine'
)

with open('scripts/eval_safelibero.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(code)

print('DONE')
